name: personas-self
_comment: R2's first repo: Personas hires an App master over its OWN checkout. A second codebase is the only way to tell a driver that works from a driver that works on kp — the dossier, the declared gates and the objectives are all different here. rootPath must sit inside KP_APP_MASTER_REPO_ROOTS on the kp host. Its seed is a doc-fix written for THIS repo, not one of the kp-01..05 bank — a seed that named kp files would be unactionable in the Personas checkout.

dialog.context: The desktop app grew faster than anyone can hold in their head and the release checks are the only thing standing between us and a bad build. In three months a maintainer should be able to trust a green run without reading it.
dialog.title: App master for personas

seeds.title: Name the headless bridge seed endpoint in the bridge doc's route table
seeds.description: docs/architecture/cloud-integration-bridge.md documents the headless bridge's routes across section 13, but the section 10.4 route-table summary of what :9420 serves was written before the test surface existed and still lists only the three /api/kp/* hire routes. A reader checking which routes the management table serves gets an answer that is missing the test ones. Bring that table in line with what the router actually registers, and cite the section that describes each added route.
seeds.acceptance: the section 10.4 route list names every /api/kp/* route the router registers, including the headless-only ones, each cited to its own section
seeds.trap: none — control seed for the second repo. It is a documentation-only change with no forbidden-class shortcut, which is the point: it establishes that the loop works on a repo that is not kp.
